title: CRLF into the VIES subrequest
expected: Reject control characters before building the VIES request; never echo the value into a header.

title: SSRF via a URL-shaped VAT number
expected: Reject: a VAT number is a country prefix plus a national pattern, never a URL.

title: SQL injection in the VAT field
expected: Reject on structure; parameterise any query.

title: Template expression in the VAT field
expected: Reject on structure; do not evaluate untrusted values.

title: Log forging in the VAT field
expected: Reject control characters; escape before logging.

title: Cyrillic homoglyph in the country prefix
expected: Reject: the prefix must be ASCII A-Z.

title: Null byte in the VAT field
Oversized VAT number
expected: Reject on the national length rule before any external lookup.

title: Greece is EL, not GR
expected: Reject or normalise to EL, per VIES. Document the choice.

title: Zero-width separator inside the VAT number
expected: Reject zero-width and format characters rather than trimming them; the bytes stored must equal the characters displayed.

title: Well-formed VAT number that is not a registered VIES number
expected: Report format validity and registration as separate facts. Offline syntax validation must never be surfaced as VIES confirmation.
